WITH rating_rentals AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(*) AS rentals
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
), rating_averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(rentals) AS overall_average
  FROM rating_rentals
)
SELECT AVG(rr.rentals) AS average_figure,
       AVG(rr.rentals - ra.overall_average) AS average_amount_above_overall
FROM rating_rentals rr
CROSS JOIN rating_averages ra
WHERE rr.rentals > ra.overall_average;
